title: Runtime feature flag IDL + gating sketch
content:
Quick brain dump / working sketch for an IDL and lightweight gating API for runtime feature flags. Goal: single small surface teams can import into client SDKs and server runtime to evaluate flags, do canaries, and wire up rollout gates without depending on a heavyweight feature-flag SaaS.

Context / motivation:
- Many teams want ephemeral gating for server-side heuristics (e.g., preferential routing, KV-cache heuristics, quantization toggles) that are versioned with model rollouts.
- Need compact stable shape that can be embedded in configs, included in commits, and reconciled by orchestration layer.
- Should support: boolean flags, param flags (numbers/strings), percentage rollouts, trait-based targeting, dependency predicates, and time-limited overrides.

Principles:
- Minimal runtime: evaluation should be sync and low-latency (<200us typical), configurable fallback to remote resolution.
- Declarative, serializable (JSON/YAML) and small.
- Deterministic evaluation order and deterministic hashing for percent gates.
- Audit-friendly: attach evaluated-conditions string to trace/span.

IDL (sketch - JSON grammar not exhaustive):
{
  "flags": {
    "flag_key": {
      "type": "bool|param|percent",
      "default": true|false|"string"|123,
      "rules": [
        {
          "id": "rule-1",
          "when": {"attr": "tenant_id", "op": "in", "values": ["acct-123"]},
          "then": {"type": "override", "value": false},
          "priority": 100
        },
        {
          "id": "p100-rollout",
          "when": {"op": "always"},
          "then": {"type": "percent", "value": 10, "hash_key": "user_id"},
          "priority": 10
        }
      ],
      "meta": {"owner": "team/infra", "expires": "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"}
    }
  }
}

Evaluation semantics notes:
- Rules sorted by priority desc, first matching rule wins (unless then.type == "chain" -> evaluate subrules).
- "percent" step: compute HMAC-SHA1(hash_key_val, instance-salt) -> uint32 -> mod 10000, compare with value*100. Salt per deployment to avoid global correlation.
- "when" supports boolean ops: eq, in, gt, lt, exists, regex, and compound AND/OR nesting.

Examples:
- Model-variant gating: flag key = "quantized-gpt4-small" param: {"bits": 4, "kv_cache": "enabled"} targeted to dedicated GPU tenants only.
- Canary: percentage rollout keyed on request.session_id for deterministic stickiness.

Runtime API (pseudo-js):
- loadFlags(source) -> FlagBundle
- evalFlag(bundle, key, context) -> {value, reason, rule_id, evaluated_conditions}
- watchForUpdates(bundle, callback) // optional push updates from control plane

Control-plane interactions / expectations:
- Service that stores and versions bundles (per-namespace): supports atomically releasing bundle id -> new bundles should be immutable.
- Orchestration: allow pinning bundle ids to routes/models so a rollout ties to a model version.

Telemetry / observability:
- Attach trace tag: flag.<key>=<value> and flag.<key>.rule=<rule_id>. Keep sampling low: only emit on changes or low-frequency debug.
- Counter metric: flag.evals.<key>.hit/<value> for high-level monitoring.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Composition: should rules support referencing other flags (dependent flip) or will that create hard-to-debug cycles? (leaning: allow but restrict to cross-namespace read-only with detection of cycles at compile time).
- Offline evaluation semantics: when context lacks hash_key, fallback deterministic strategy? (return default and log).
- Policy for salt rotation and migration across clusters.
- Schema evolution: how to mark new predicate operators without breaking older runtimes.

Action items (next steps):
- Draft minimal proto/JSON schema and small JS/Go evaluator with ~50 LOC that we can ship in client-proxy. Assigned: Marco. ETA: 2 weeks.
- Confluence: write longer proposal + examples. Owner: Leah.
- Instrumentation RFC: define trace keys and metrics. Owner: Priya.

Notes-to-self:
- Keep the bundle size small (prefer per-route bundles rather than global megabundle).
- Consider built-in "rollout-safeguard" rule type that auto-fails to default when errors in evaluation occur.
- Verify HMAC salt source: per-cluster KMS-derived; include migration tool for salt rotation.

Snippets / sketch of small rule language for human-editable YAML (for SREs):
flags:
  eager-ai-fallthrough:
    type: bool
    default: false
    rules:
      - id: internal-only
        when:
          attr: peer_env
          eq: "staging"
        then:
          override: true

End of sketch. This is intentionally terse and rough — mainly a working notebook to capture surfaces and tradeoffs. Will convert to formal spec after feedback from eng-runtime and infra teams.
